description.value: A longitudinal fMRI study examined whether changes in PTSD symptom severity were associated with changes in BOLD responses during an affective Stroop task in trauma-exposed military service members.

spans.text: This study examined the neural correlates of changing PTSD symptom levels in TEIs.
